It designs, develops, manufactures and sells products including [[air conditioner]]s, [[Cooler|air cooler]]s, [[refrigerator]]s, [[washing machine]]s, [[dishwasher]]s, [[Microwave oven|microwave]]s, [[air purifier]]s, [[water dispenser]]s. Voltas is India's largest air conditioning company by market share.{{cite web | url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/companies/voltas-share-price-vs-blue-star-share-price-in-2022-15275131.htm | title=Here's why 2022 has been a very different year for two of India's biggest AC makers | date=29 November 2022 }}{{cite web | url=https://www.ibef.org/industry/indian-consumer-market/showcase/voltas-ltd#:~:text=It%20was%20a%20leader%20in,offices%20across%20major%20Indian%20cities. | title=Voltas Ltd | Consumer Durables }} The company was incorporated on 6 September 1954 in Mumbai, as a collaboration between [[Tata Sons]] and [[Volkart Brothers]]. The company is currently chaired by [[Noel Tata]]{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/durables/voltas-appoints-noel-tata-aschairman-from-september/articleshow/59884005.cms|title=Voltas appoints Noel Tata as chairman from September|last=Mukherjee|first=Writankar|date=2 August 2017|work=The Economic Times|access-date=23 January 2018}} and Mukundan Menon is the company's current [[chief executive officer]] and [[managing director]].{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/durables/voltas-elevates-pradeepbakshi-as-md-and-ceo/articleshow/61104941.cms|title=Voltas elevates Pradeep Bakshi as MD and CEO|last=Mukherjee|first=Writankar|date=16 October 2017|work=The Economic Times|access-date=23 January 2018}} ==Operations== The company is broadly structured into projects and products business. The projects business is divided into Domestic Projects Group and International Operations Business Group. Meanwhile, the products business is classified into Unitary Products Business Group, Mining & Construction Equipment Division, and Textile Machinery Division. The Unitary Products business group manufacture products in categories including air conditioners, air coolers,{{Citation|title=Voltas forays into air coolers to reach larger masses|website=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/et-now/corporate/voltas-forays-into-air-coolers-to-reach-larger-masses/videoshow/47160437.cms|date=5 May 2015 |access-date=23 January 2018}} commercial refrigerators, water coolers, and water dispensers. Voltas{{Cite web|url=https://brandequity.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/marketing/brand-wars-korean-ac-brandsfeel-the-heat/59860784|title=Brand wars: Korean AC companies feel the heat|website=ETBrandEquity.com|language=en|access-date=23 January 2018}} is the largest [[air conditioning]] brand in India. It started manufacturing air conditioners in the 1960s under license from the [[Carrier Global|Carrier Corporation]].{{Cite web |url=https://www.voltas.com/history |title=Voltas | History |access-date=3 June 2021 |archive-date=26 April 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210426202017/https://www.voltas.com/history |url-status=dead }} Voltas produced India's first window air conditioner with DC-inverter-based variable-speed motors.{{Cite web|url=http://www.voltas.com/news/spotlight/Voltas_launches_India%E2%80%99s_first_Window_AC_with_Inverter_Technology.asp|title=Voltas launches India's first Window AC with Inverter Technology|website=www.voltas.com|access-date=22 February 2018|archive-date=28 September 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180928212154/http://www.voltas.com/news/spotlight/Voltas_launches_India%E2%80%99s_first_Window_AC_with_Inverter_Technology.asp|url-status=dead}} DC Inverter Technology is an innovative technology that provides superior cooling while reducing the frequency of turning the compressor on and off. This helps in reducing the power consumption to a greater extent.{{Cite web|url=https://bestac.in/best-ac-india/|title=12 Best Air Conditioners in India 2021 – Buyer's Guide & Reviews|website=www.bestac.in|access-date=17 April 2021|archive-date=17 April 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210417101429/https://bestac.in/best-ac-india/|url-status=dead}} Voltas also has a large network of repair centers. The firm is also a major producer of evaporative coolers,{{Cite web|url=http://equitybulls.com/admin/news2006/news_det.asp?id=224460|title=Voltas fortifies its leadership position by introducing its 2018 range of cooling products - EquityBulls.com|website=equitybulls.com|date=14 March 2018|access-date=16 March 2018|archive-date=5 December 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211205142016/https://equitybulls.com/admin/news2006/news_det.asp?id=224460|url-status=dead}} which are widely used for comfort cooling in arid and semi-arid climates. Voltas has a partnership for compressor with Elgi Equipments, a compressor manufacturing firm. Voltas has also entered into a joint venture with Turkey-based Ardutch (a subsidiary of [[Arçelik]], part of the [[Koç]] Group making the [[Beko]] brand of home appliances). It began producing refrigerators, air conditioners, washing machines and kitchen appliances under the name of [[Voltas Beko]].{{Cite news|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/voltas-targets-3500cr-sales-from-beko-range-ofconsumer-durables/article9715337.ece|title=Voltas targets ₹3,500-cr sales from Beko range of consumer durables|last=Chatterjee|first=Purvita|date=29 May 2017|work=The Hindu Business Line|access-date=23 January 2018|language=en}} Voltas has completed many international projects, including air conditioning in the world's tallest building, the [[Burj Khalifa]], in the once largest ocean liner, {{RMS|Queen Mary 2}}, [[Al Alam Palace|Palace of Sultanate of Oman]], [[City Centre Bahrain|Bahrain City Centre Mall]], [[Ferrari World Abu Dhabi|Ferrari World Theme Park]] in Abu Dhabi, [[Sidra Medical and Research Center|Sidra Medical and Research Centre]] in Qatar, [[Villaggio Mall]] in Qatar and [[Mall of the Emirates|Dubai's Mall of Emirates]]. ==Voltas Beko== {{Infobox company | name = Voltas Beko | logo = Logo_of_Voltas_Beko.png | logo_upright = | logo_alt = Blue logo of VoltasBeko | type = [[Joint venture]] | industry = {{plainlist|[[Home appliance]]s}} | founded = {{start date and age|2017}}{{cite news |last=Karwa|first=Krishna |title=Voltas-Beko: How the tie-up bodes for India's leading AC brand|url= https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/voltas-beko-how-the-tie-up-bodes-for-indias-leading-ac-brand-2980651.html|work= MoneyControl |date=2018-09-25|access-date=2024-03-01}} | hq_location = [[Mumbai]], [[Maharashtra]] | area_served = India | key_people = Jayant Balan (CEO) | products = Refrigerator

extract:
Voltas Limited is an Indian multinational home appliance company, headquartered in Mumbai. It designs, develops, manufactures and sells products including air conditioners, air coolers, refrigerators, washing machines, dishwashers, microwaves, air purifiers, water dispensers. Voltas is India's largest air conditioning company by market share.  
The company was incorporated on 6 September 1954 in Mumbai, as a collaboration between Tata Sons and Volkart Brothers. The company is currently chaired by Noel Tata and Mukundan Menon is the company's current chief executive officer and managing director.
